_comment: One hardware class per timing profile, shared by every method so that a
profile table compares methods on identical hardware.  Enforced by the
timing stage (pre-flight in the launcher and runner, and inside every
measuring process).  cpu_model is compared with /proc/cpuinfo 'model name',
after collapsing whitespace, 'regex:<pattern>' for a full regex match, or
'any' to disable one check explicitly.  An empty value blocks timing runs of
that profile until the class is declared; the error message prints the
hardware detected on the allocated node.  slurm_hint is documentation for

cpu_1core.slurm_hint: sbatch --nodelist=n237 (or another verified AMD EPYC 7313 node)

cpu_postgres_2core.slurm_hint: sbatch --nodelist=n237 (or another verified AMD EPYC 7313 node)

cpu_fullnode_exclusive.slurm_hint: sbatch --nodelist=n237 (or another verified AMD EPYC 7313 node)
